# Scotland Extension

Scottish succession law — prior rights, legal rights, confirmation, cohabitation claims under Family Law (Scotland) Act 2006, intestacy (Succession (Scotland) Act 1964 as amended 2024), heritable/moveable classification, executry, survivorship destinations, crofting succession, LBTT

Source: [`v3/extensions/scotland/scotland.json`](../../../../v3/extensions/scotland/scotland.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/extensions/scotland/scotland.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `priorRights` | `object` | | Prior rights of the surviving spouse/civil partner under Succession (Scotland) Act 1964 ss.8-9 |
| `legalRights` | `object` | | Legal rights (jus relictae/jus relicti for spouse, legitim for children) — fixed fractions of moveable estate that cannot be defeated by will |
| `confirmation` | `object` | | Scottish equivalent of probate — confirmation is granted by the Sheriff Court |
| `cohabitationClaim` | `object` | | Claims by cohabitants under Family Law (Scotland) Act 2006 s.29 |
| `forcedHeirship` | `object` | | Scotland has no forced heirship for heritable property — only legal rights apply to moveables. This field records whether the testator has attempted to defeat legal rights. |
| `legislativeChanges` | array of [TemporalRule](../../common/temporal-rule.md) | | Tracked changes to Scottish succession legislation |
| `notes` | `string` | | |
| `intestacy` | `object` | | Intestacy calculation under Succession (Scotland) Act 1964 as amended by Trusts and Succession (Scotland) Act 2024 |
| `heritableMoveableClassifications` | array of `object` | | Classification of estate items as heritable or moveable under Scots law — legal rights apply only to moveables |
| `totalHeritableValue` | [Money](../../common/money.md) | | Sum of all heritable items |
| `totalMoveableValue` | [Money](../../common/money.md) | | Sum of all moveable items |
| `executryAppointments` | array of `object` | | Scottish-specific executor appointment details — nominate (by will), dative (by court), creditor (by creditor petition) |
| `survivorshipDestinations` | array of `object` | | Properties with survivorship destinations ('to A and B and the survivor') — pass outside the estate, overriding any will |
| `croftingSuccession` | `object` | | Crofting succession under Crofters (Scotland) Act 1993 — special rules for crofting tenancies |
| `willFormalities` | `object` | | Scottish will formalities under Requirements of Writing (Scotland) Act 1995 |
| `lbttExemption` | `object` | | LBTT succession exemption under LBTT(S) Act 2013 — estate transfers are exempt, but inherited dwellings affect ADS |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
